statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Agents declare their supported extensions in the AgentCard using the extensions field, which contains an array of AgentExtension objects.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: AgentExtension uri field — the URI identifier for the extension, e.g. 'https://standards.org/extensions/citations/v1'. Extensions SHOULD include version information in their URI identifier.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: AgentExtension description field — human-readable description of what the extension provides, e.g. 'Provides citation formatting and source verification'.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: AgentExtension required field — boolean indicating whether the extension is required for the agent interaction. Referenced in 4.6.3: 'unless the extension is marked as required in the AgentCard'.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Messages can be extended using the extensions field to allow clients to provide additional strongly typed context or parameters relevant to the message being sent, or TaskStatus Messages to include extra information about the task's progress.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Messages include a metadata field for extension-specific data, keyed by extension URI, providing strongly typed context for each declared extension.
statements.field_type: object (map of extension URI string to extension-specific data object)

statements.subject: artifact
statements.description: Artifacts can include extension data using the extensions field to provide strongly typed context or metadata about the generated content.

statements.subject: artifact
statements.description: Artifacts include a metadata field for extension-specific data, keyed by extension URI, providing strongly typed context about the generated content.
statements.field_type: object (map of extension URI string to extension-specific data object)

statements.subject: extension
statements.description: If a client requests a version of an extension that the agent does not support, the agent SHOULD ignore the extension for that interaction and proceed without it, unless the extension is marked as required in the AgentCard.
actions: agent ignores the unsupported extension for the current interaction
agent proceeds with the interaction without the extension

statements.subject: extension
statements.description: If the extension is marked as required in the AgentCard and the agent does not support the requested version, the agent MUST return an error indicating unsupported extension.
actions: agent returns an error indicating unsupported extension

statements.subject: extension
statements.description: It MUST NOT fall back to a previous version of the extension automatically.
actions: agent does not automatically fall back to any previous version of the extension
